title: Measuring the Reconstruction Contract Cost for an Insurance Claim Services Dwelling Release
content:
For the insured's dwelling release on an Insurance Claim Services file, the cost of the Reconstruction contract that enters the billed cost turns on the contract's status.

**Rule.** The contract cost is measured as follows: when the contract is closed, by the draw payments and insurance postings received on it, because a closed contract's cost is what was paid; when the contract is final invoiced, by its final invoice amount; otherwise by the contract amount plus the change order charges less the change order credits.

| Contract status | Contract cost taken as |
|---|---|
| closed | the draw payments and insurance payments received on the contract, together |
| final invoiced | the contract's final invoice amount |
| any other (for instance substantially complete) | the contract amount plus the change order charges less the change order credits |

*Hypothetical:* a contract whose draw payments total 36500.00 and insurance postings 7200.00, with a final invoice amount of 44100.00. Closed: 43700.00. Final invoiced: 44100.00.
